moment: The narrator establishes that Jacob Marley has been dead for seven years.
Fred visits Scrooge at work and invites him to Christmas dinner.
Scrooge refuses to give money to the charity collectors.
Scrooge reluctantly gives Bob Cratchit Christmas Day off.
At home Scrooge sees Marley's face in his door knocker.
Marley's ghost shows Scrooge his chain and warns him that three spirits will visit.
The Ghost of Christmas Past appears beside Scrooge's bed.
Scrooge sees himself as a lonely boy left at school over Christmas.
Scrooge's sister Fan arrives at his school to bring him home.
Fezziwig throws a Christmas party for his employees and friends.
Belle ends her engagement to Scrooge because money has become more important to him.
After seeing Belle with her family, Scrooge presses the spirit's cap over its light.
Scrooge finds the Ghost of Christmas Present sitting among piles of festive food.
The spirit shows the Cratchits sharing Christmas dinner.
The spirit warns that Tiny Tim will die if the future remains unchanged.
Bob proposes a toast to Scrooge, and Mrs Cratchit objects.
Scrooge watches Fred and his guests play a guessing game at their Christmas party.
The spirit reveals two children named Ignorance and Want.
The Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come approaches in a dark robe and points silently.
Businessmen discuss a man's death and joke about attending his funeral.
At Old Joe's shop, thieves sell belongings taken from the dead man.
Scrooge sees a dead man's covered body and cannot bring himself to lift the sheet.
Scrooge visits the grieving Cratchits and learns that Tiny Tim has died.
Scrooge reads his own name on the gravestone and promises to change.
Scrooge wakes in his own bed and realises he can still change his future.
A boy tells Scrooge it is Christmas Day, and Scrooge sends a prize turkey to the Cratchits.
Scrooge meets one of the charity collectors and promises a generous donation.
Scrooge joins Fred and his guests for Christmas dinner.
When Bob arrives late the next morning, Scrooge surprises him with a pay rise.
Tiny Tim survives, and Scrooge becomes like a second father to him.
